name: asc-tea-platform
description: Root dev-orchestration for the ASC Tea Auction platform (frontend + backend run separately as their own projects).

scripts.dev: npm run db:start && concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env DOTNET_gcServer=0 dotnet run --project backend/Asc.Api --urls http://0.0.0.0:5058
